name: Bun v1.4.3
body:
To install Bun v1.4.3
```bash
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
# or you can use npm
# npm install -g bun
```

Windows:
```bash
powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1|iex"
```

To upgrade to Bun v1.4.3:
```bash
bun upgrade
```

### [Read Bun v1.4.3's release notes on Bun's blog](https://bun.com/blog/bun-v1.4.3)
